title: Runescape Dragonwilds - Kuldra (Solo, Melee, No Damage)
author: Shadiochao
description:
Defeating the final boss of the Runescape Dragonwilds, using melee and without taking any damage.  

This one took many more attempts than all the others, so I played the last phase very safe because the worms are scary

comments.text: ​ @Shadiochao poison puddles, freezing shards and one or two completely mistimed rolls through a laserbeam. Come on man, I can tell you're good at the game, but it was obvious. Why would you cheat it, just accept the challenge.

comments.author: @Shadiochao
comments.text:
@drakebane9527  Poison puddles and the icicles don't damage you directly, they build up a status effect which you can see on the bottom left. If I let the poison bar fill all the way I would've taken damage, I think the freezing bar just slows stamina regen  

As for the beam, rolling has a very lenient invicibility window. Sometimes you can even spam roll, which I prefer to use for the beam because its hitbox isn't very clear
